scripts.serve: cd src && cp --parents -R components/**/*.html static/ && cd .. && vite serve
scripts.build: cd src && cp --parents -R components/**/*.html static/ && cd .. && vite build
scripts.serve_win: cd src && xcopy components\*.html static\components\ /S && cd .. && vite serve
scripts.build_win: cd src && xcopy components\*.html static\components\ /S && cd .. && vite build
